text: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is an instant payment system developed by the National Payments Corporation of India.
UPI enables users to transfer money instantly between participating bank accounts using a mobile application.
The Reserve Bank of India regulates payment systems and has supported the development and expansion of digital payments in India.
UPI continues to be available as a digital payment system for customers of participating banks.
The Reserve Bank of India has not announced that UPI will be discontinued.
